declaredGaps: OO opens "Paragraph advanced settings" from the ctx menu row (census-oo-deep contextMenu, enabled) and the right panel "Show advanced settings"; the committed OO dialog census captured no field-level paragraph modal — the field contract is pinned from the MS-Word-style Indents & Spacing shape (alignment, left/right/first-line indents, line spacing, keeps, page break, Tabs…, OK/Cancel)

OO additionally carries Before/After paragraph spacing + "Don't add interval between paragraphs of the same style" (right-panel census) — WO defers those to the ribbon line-spacing control and right panel; recorded divergence, not gated

contract.open: real right-click on the caret paragraph + ctx-menu row button[data-ctx="ParagraphSettings"] (editor.js: openParagraphSettingsDialog)
contract.title: Paragraph advanced settings
contract.behavior: OK applies text-align/margins/text-indent/line-height inline styles + keep-lines-together/keep-with-next/page-break-before classes to the caret block (flat HTML); reopen reads the live block back into every field; zero values remove styles; Cancel mutates nothing
